3.1 Inflammation

Inflammation is the body’s response to injury or infection.

Cardinal signs: - Rubor - Calor - Tumor - Dolor - Functio laesa

Chronic inflammation is linked to: - Cancer - Cardiovascular disease -
Autoimmune disorders

metadata.document_summary: This research article explores the mechanisms of inflammation, detailing symptoms and related conditions. It aims to provide insights for medical researchers and clinicians in understanding and managing inflammatory diseases.
